notes.title: Patchnotes #1
notes.content:
I have received feedback from some players who were not entirely satisfied with the game experience. I have therefore made the following changes to the game:

- Fixed performance issues in several locations.
- Tasks are now displayed divided into main and secondary tasks to show the player which tasks are really important.
- Added subtitles for the opening video.
- Some tips have been added or adjusted to make it easier for players to find the clues in the locations.
- The walking speed in the forest has been slightly increased. 
- More random events have been implemented to make the game more eventful.
- A recurring scene can now be skipped with the menu key (ESC).
- The running speed after this scene has been adjusted.
- A feature has been implemented that allows the player to lower the difficulty of this scene after multiple failures. 
- Missing sound effects have been corrected.
- Several light sources have been added.
- Other known bugs have been fixed.
